verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents general API key access and admin/permission controls (docs-11, docs-6, docs-9), but there is no evidence of scoped, least-privilege credentials issued specifically per agent (e.g., token scoping, role-based API key restrictions tied to individual agents). missing for 10: documented per-agent scoped API key creation, least-privilege credential model, evidence of granular permission enforcement at the API-key level.
